ar.title: دجاج بصلصة الرمان والجوز
ar.intro: طبق فارسي، دجاج بصلصة رمان وجوز حلوة وحامضة.

steps.n1: قطّع الدجاج إلى قطع ناضرة واقليها بخفة من جميع الجوانب وضعها جانباً.
steps.n3: أضف الجوز والمرق والسكر وعصير الرمان والملح والفلفل واطهِ حتى تغلظ الصلصة.
steps.n4: أعيد الدجاج واطهِ على نار منخفضة لمدة 20–25 دقيقة أخرى.

en.title: Chicken in Pomegranate and Walnut Sauce (Fesenjan)
en.intro: Recipe 121, page 56 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

steps.n1: Cut the chickens into neat joints, fry them lightly on all sides and keep them warm.
steps.n2: Soften the onions in the same oil.
steps.n3: Add the walnuts, broth, sugar, pomegranate juice, salt and pepper and cook until the sauce thickens.
steps.n4: Return the chicken and cook over a low heat for 20–25 minutes more.

legacySteps: Cut the chickens into neat joints, fry them lightly on all sides and keep them warm.
Soften the onions in the same oil.
Add the walnuts, broth, sugar, pomegranate juice, salt and pepper and cook until the sauce thickens.
Return the chicken and cook over a low heat for 20–25 minutes more.
